verdicts.decision_note: The client selects a standard 120V wall-powered V1 configuration, excludes battery power from V1, and establishes simplicity and event reliability as power-architecture acceptance criteria.
First target-specific design implementation claim identifying the 120V-to-12V 20A supply, PWM controllers, and 12V cooling loads.
The client adds a concrete electrical-capacity acceptance condition requiring the supply to support both motors, solenoids, and fans under simultaneous load.
Target-specific post-concern implementation claim reporting a completed BOM change to higher-power controllers and a 50A supply with thermal and overload reserve.
The client's unambiguous BOM approval confirms the 50A supply, higher-power PWM controllers, and reserve-capacity configuration described in the immediately preceding exchange.
The client requires the selected bowl LEDs to be electrically compatible with the existing machine setup, adding a concrete power-configuration compatibility condition.
The client adds powered accent lighting, including illumination around the power button, as an additional electrical load that the established power-capacity condition must support.
